LAW AND MOTION 301, NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT KIMBERLEE DICKERSON'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED; DEFENDANT FAILED TO CARRY HER BURDEN OF SUPPORTING EVERY ELEMENT OF HER EXCLUSIVE REMEDY AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE BECAUSE HER MOVING PAPERS INCLUDE NO EVIDENCE THAT THE COMMON EMPLOYER WAS PROPERLY INSURED. IN ANY EVENT, THERE REMAINS A TRIABLE ISSUE WHETHER DEFENDANT WAS ACTING WITHIN THE SCOPE OF HER EMPLOYMENT WHEN SHE INJURED PLAINTIFF. OPPOSING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
